text: This Motion seeks authorization to amend the 2018 Operating Budget of Heritage Toronto to fund the creation and installation of a heritage plaque to commemorate Maple Leaf Stadium. Maple Leaf Stadium was a jewel box-style baseball stadium in Toronto located at the foot of Bathurst Street and Lakeshore Boulevard (formerly Fleet Street). It was built in 1926 for the Toronto Maple Leafs baseball team of the International League. Previously, the Maple Leafs had played at Hanlan's Point Stadium. It continued to be the home of the Leafs for 42 seasons, until the team left town following the 1967 season. The stadium was demolished in 1968.
